arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SLA-PROBE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-DAYS-SINCE-UPD PIC 99.
       01 WS-SLA-STATUS PIC X(7).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT WS-DAYS-SINCE-UPD
           IF WS-DAYS-SINCE-UPD >= 7
              MOVE 'OVERDUE' TO WS-SLA-STATUS
           ELSE
              MOVE 'INSLA' TO WS-SLA-STATUS
           END-IF
           DISPLAY 'SLA: ' WS-SLA-STATUS
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SLA-PROBE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-DAYS-SINCE-UPD PIC 99.
       01 WS-SLA-STATUS PIC X(7).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 7 TO WS-DAYS-SINCE-UPD
           IF WS-DAYS-SINCE-UPD >= 7
              MOVE 'OVERDUE' TO WS-SLA-STATUS
           ELSE
              MOVE 'INSLA' TO WS-SLA-STATUS
           END-IF
           DISPLAY 'SLA: ' WS-SLA-STATUS
           STOP RUN.
